chunks: And from him, from al-Maythamī, from Abān, from Ismāʿīl al-Juʿfī, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

Do you know why one dhirāʿ and two dhirāʿs were appointed? He said: I said: Why? He said: Because of the place of the obligatory prayer. He said: So that time is not taken from the time of this one and entered into the time of that one.

key_terms.الذِّرَاعَانِ: two cubits; a timing marker related to prayer times
key_terms.الذِّرَاعُ: a measure used here to indicate a determined point in prayer timing
key_terms.هَذِهِ: this prayer referred to in the timing distinction
key_terms.وَقْتِ: the prescribed time of a prayer

ai.seo_question: Why were one dhirāʿ and two dhirāʿs designated in the timing of zuhr and ʿasr prayers?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the designation of one dhirāʿ and two dhirāʿs in relation to the timing of the obligatory prayers. The purpose is to preserve the proper time allocation of each prayer so that the time of one obligatory prayer is not taken and merged into the time of another.
